note: Our reading of each source's terms on the verification date. Not legal advice. Details and quoted provisions: docs/DATA-LICENSING-AUDIT.md.

sources.name: Clinical Trial Decision Lab synthetic cases v1
sources.origin: Generated by this project (src/triallab/synthetic), fixed seeds
sources.role_in_project: Benchmark dataset for the synthetic operational triage track
sources.notes: Fictional. No real participant, site, sponsor, study or product. Case mix is a design choice.

sources.name: Fraud Decision Lab v0.2.0 (source code)
sources.role_in_project: Benchmark infrastructure copied into src/triallab/core and adapted in providers/
sources.notes: Same copyright holder and licence as this project.

sources.name: FDA warning letters and disqualification documents (bioresearch monitoring)
sources.source_version: 115 letters and disqualification documents dated 1995-04-13 to 2026-08-27
sources.license: U.S. Government work; public domain in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105)
sources.rights_holder: none (U.S. Food and Drug Administration is the author)
sources.role_in_project: Source for the regulatory-finding track. Kept outside this repository.
sources.notes: Copyright: free to use. Privacy: letters name individual investigators and FDA staff, which is personal data for an EU publisher. Per-case material, source URLs and letter numbers stay out of the repository until a privacy review is complete. External API processing of de-named descriptions awaits an owner decision.

sources.name: OHRP determination letters
sources.license: U.S. Government work; public domain in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105). HHS reuse policy could not be verified.
sources.rights_holder: none (HHS Office for Human Research Protections is the author)
sources.role_in_project: Second source for the regulatory-finding track. Kept outside this repository.
sources.notes: Copyright position rests on 17 U.S.C. 105 alone; no HHS reuse or attribution policy was verified. Every letter names its addressee and OHRP staff. Letters from 2000 to 2012 were not reachable. Same handling as the FDA letters: nothing per-case enters the repository.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
sources.source_version: API v2, studies first registered since July 2026, retrieved 2026-11-17
sources.rights_holder: U.S. National Library of Medicine; third parties for some content
sources.role_in_project: One exploratory pilot (rule flags on 1,000 registry records, 408 items). Only aggregate scores and record identifiers with labels are in the repository.
sources.notes: Terms ask for attribution, the processing date and a description of modifications, and forbid asserting proprietary rights. Third-party copyright applies to some content. The terms page did not render for our reader on 2026-11-26, so the reading of 2026-11-16 stands. studies/screening/review/reference-labels-human-checked.json lists registry identifiers with our own labels; no registry text is stored.

sources.name: AACT (CTTI)
sources.role_in_project: Not used. Terms could not be read without creating an account.
sources.notes: Excluded until its terms are read and recorded.

sources.name: CDISC SDTM/ADaM Pilot 01
sources.license: README terms of use; no licence file
sources.rights_holder: CDISC; data provided by Eli Lilly and Company
sources.role_in_project: Not used. Never to be copied into this repository.
sources.notes: Terms forbid modifying the data, distributing it for a fee, and distributing it without attribution to CDISC. It has no eligibility or deviation datasets.

sources.name: PHUSE phuse-scripts and safetyData
sources.license: MIT stated, without a copyright holder; upstream CDISC terms unresolved
sources.notes: A downstream MIT label does not override the upstream CDISC terms. Treated as governed by the CDISC pilot terms.

sources.name: Gilead gsm.datasim
sources.role_in_project: Evaluated as the generator; not used. Not a dependency.
sources.notes: Licence allows every use. Not adopted for scientific reasons: its eligibility results are random and its consent fields are constants, so it cannot express protocol thresholds, consent versions or timing. It is also an R package; this project is Python only.

sources.name: OpenRBQM / Good Statistical Monitoring (gsm.core, gsm.kri, gsm.mapping, gsm.reporting)
sources.source_version: gsm.core v1.3.2, gsm.kri v1.8.0, gsm.mapping v1.2.0
sources.role_in_project: Optional external tool. Not bundled, not a dependency, not executed.
sources.notes: Site-level indicators, not per-participant triage; reported separately if ever run. Its sample data package (clindata) is described as both synthetic and anonymised and must not be redistributed.

sources.name: CDISC CORE (rules engine and open rules)
sources.license: MIT (engine and rule repositories); CDISC Library content under its own terms
sources.role_in_project: Optional external tool. Not bundled, not a dependency, not executed.
sources.notes: CDISC Library licence text could not be obtained; cached Library content and API responses must not be published. Standards documents are for internal use only.

sources.name: pharmaverse sdtmchecks
sources.role_in_project: Optional external tool. Not bundled, not a dependency, not executed.
sources.notes: No eligibility-criteria checks; one consent-date check. Thin coverage for this topic.

sources.name: IMPALA Clinical Trial Anomaly Spotter
sources.role_in_project: Possible future experiment only. Not used.
sources.notes: Needs longitudinal numeric series. GPL dependencies; never bundle.

sources.name: Project Data Sphere
sources.rights_holder: Project Data Sphere and data providers
sources.role_in_project: Possible future source only. Not used.
sources.notes: Access is per individual and limited to cancer research. No external AI APIs, no redistribution, no per-case publication.

sources.name: TrialPanorama benchmark (study_screening task)
sources.rights_holder: TrialPanorama authors; the underlying reviews and papers belong to their publishers and authors
sources.role_in_project: Source of review-to-paper membership labels (included or excluded) for the screening study and its pilots.
sources.notes: Only identifiers, labels and review titles derived from the benchmark are in the repository (studies/screening). The benchmark files themselves are not copied. The dataset card names no individual rights holder and does not describe the source of the labels; the licence was read from the card metadata. Review text (objectives, criteria) in the benchmark comes from published reviews, including Cochrane reviews, and is not stored here. Apache-2.0 permits redistribution with attribution; the derived identifiers, labels and review titles keep that licence and its notice and are not relicensed under MIT (same treatment as other Apache-2.0 material in this register).

sources.name: Europe PMC (article metadata, abstracts, licence information)
sources.license: Each article's own licence; only CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA and CC BY-ND records were used
sources.rights_holder: Authors and publishers of each article; EMBL-EBI for the service
sources.role_in_project: Source of paper titles, abstracts and licence fields for the screening study, its pilots and the classifier training data.
sources.notes: Decisions apply to the open-licence subset only. Abstracts were sent to model providers only when the record carried CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA or CC BY-ND; no abstract or title is stored in the repository. Europe PMC's own copyright page returned HTTP 403 to our reader on 2026-11-26, so the service terms were not re-read on that date. CC BY-ND forbids sharing adapted versions; CC BY and CC BY-SA need attribution if text is ever redistributed.

sources.name: SYNERGY / SYNERGY+ (ASReview)
sources.license: CC0 1.0 for the dataset; abstract text keeps its publisher's or article's terms
sources.rights_holder: ASReview / Utrecht University for the collection; publishers and authors for abstracts
sources.role_in_project: Labels for one exploratory abstract-screening pilot (584 open-licence abstracts from 6 reviews).
sources.notes: Only aggregate pilot scores are in the repository. Abstracts were fetched separately and used only where the article carried an open licence. The README says abstracts are provided for machine-learning purposes and states no reuse terms for the text.

sensitive_data.scope: Automated Microsoft Presidio scan (presidio-analyzer 2.2.366, en_core_web_lg 3.8.0) of every publishable file, run with `make pii` on 2026-11-26: 155 files, no unreviewed finding, 76 allowlist rules in configs/presidio-allowlist.txt. Owner decision to use this scan in place of a human review of every file. No person read every file.

legal.scope: Owner risk decision without specialist legal review. Items considered: provider terms for the five tested hosted models (Perplexity requires permission that was not obtained; Bespoke Labs published no terms that we could find; OpenRouter and Google do not address benchmark publication), open-licence abstracts only, review titles as bibliographic references, CC BY Cochrane reviews in one pilot. Raw provider outputs are withheld. Track A stays unpublished.

clinical_expert.scope: Review of reference-label rules and the provisional regulatory-finding labels by a qualified clinical-compliance expert.
